verdict.rationale: INPI is the French IP office's filing and registry service, covering trademark, patent, design and e-Soleau filings plus IP data access. It has no user-built automations that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so this automation-lifecycle story is a category error for this kind of product. The token-gated open-data portal is a data-access API, not an automation platform, and does not make the axis applicable.
